# SIDE B — Tokyo Music Bar Guide

SIDE B is a Japanese-first editorial guide for choosing Tokyo music bars by sound, atmosphere, neighborhood, and price.

Prototype URL: https://tsutou.github.io/side-b/
Repository: https://github.com/Tsutou/side-b

## Current data status

All seven venues, locations, hours, prices, descriptions, and map positions in this prototype are fictional. They must not be cited as facts about real businesses.

## Languages

- Japanese is the default interface language.
- English can be selected in the interface.

## Product scope

The prototype includes a schematic map, an editorial guide, venue detail views, and device-local saved places. It does not yet contain verified venue listings, live directions, accounts, or analytics.
